scope: Actual production editor + isolated HTTP fixtures + real Python clean_document for writes; real IndexedDB. No live/private Supabase or physical-device validation.
results: Selected font/size/color/highlight and document/paragraph styles survive real Python validation without changing session credit
Title, Subtitle, H1–H3 and normal styles retain semantic structure
Clear formatting preserves provenance; one undo restores formats and redo does not count words again
Checklist toggles, checkbox state, Enter, Tab and Shift+Tab work through the official nested-list commands
Optional selection toolbar formats existing selection, avoids overlap and can be disabled without remounting the editor
All three formatting panels fit five viewport widths and pass axe WCAG 2/2.1 AA checks
Reopen preserves root typography, text marks, paragraph attributes, checklist state and session history
Offline formatting stays local and synchronizes intact after reconnect
Large text and maximum paragraph indentation remain contained at 320px
Formatting an existing draft without typing does not start a session or award words
